title: 第7章 有妖气
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
下午六点。

    李父接上李西洛，回到家。

    李母正在做晚饭，李西海躺在沙发上玩手机。

    李父坐在单人沙发上，掏出烟盒，微微犹豫，还是伸手散了一支给李西海。

    李西海顺手接过卡在耳朵上。

    “不抽？”李父问道。

    “你先抽，两个人抽烟雾大，等下妈要说。”

    李西海说道，他才抽过一支，不太想抽。

    “嗯。”

    李父应了一声。

    两父子就这样，没有谁开口。

    过了一会儿，李父随口道：“久岸医疗今天又涨停了。”

    “没卖，还在格局中。”李西海继续刷着手机，看的是三角洲行动视频。

    “还格局？”

    李父倒是知道格局的说法，他有点好奇的问道：“你很看好久岸医疗？”

    “行情不错吧，反正现在流感严重，久岸在国外的业务很是不错。”

    李西海根据系统给出的分析，如是说道。

    他是不太了解久岸医疗的情况，都是从系统那里获悉的信息。

    以前他也不过是个普通的炒股选手，当初凭借一头热血闯进来，学的全部都是皮毛。

    能有多少投资经验，理论基础知识？

    说白了。

    他就是一个纯纯的小白选手。

    要没系统，他都不敢再投资。

    既然有系统这金手指，李西海也懒得去费什么精力脑细胞的。

    有系统还努力上进，成天钻研这个理论，分析那个数据的。

    那特么系统不是白来了吗？

    所以啊，躺平就完了。

    不要瞎操作，不要胡思乱想。

    老老实实的根据系统指导投资，那不香嘛？

    “你心里有数就好。”

    李父也不再多言语。

    今天之所以问，就是因为连续三天的涨停，三十多万的收益，让他也不得不重视起来。

    他倒是没多少担忧。

    有时候想的很通透，赚到的那是儿子眼光到位，有格局定力。

    赔进去也不亏，反正都是算是赚来的。

    只是他担心要是出现什么变故，三十多万赔进去，儿子心里承受不了这巨大落差，情绪出现问题。

    “吃饭了。”

    李母喊道。

    李西海跟李父起身过去，李西洛也从房间出来。

    一家人吃完饭，李母见李西海吃的少，警惕的问道：“你今天晚上不会又出去吧？”

    “成天夜不归宿，家里成你酒店宾馆了。”
content_en:
6pm.

    Father Li picked up Li Xiluo and returned home.

    Li's mother was making dinner, and Li Xihai was lying on the sofa playing with his mobile phone.

    Father Li sat on the single sofa, took out his cigarette case, hesitated slightly, and then reached out and handed one to Li Xihai.

    Li Xihai took it and stuck it on his ear.

    "Don't smoke?" Father Li asked.

    "You smoke first. It's a lot of smoke between two people. Mom will have to say something later."

    Li Xihai said that he had only smoked one and didn't really want to smoke one.

    "Yeah."

    Father Li responded.

    The two father and son were like this, no one spoke.

    After a while, Li's father casually said: "Jiu'an Medical has reached its daily limit again today."

    "It's not sold, it's still in the process." Li Xihai continued to browse the mobile phone, watching the video of Operation Delta.

    "Return to the pattern?"

    Father Li knew what the pattern was saying. He asked curiously: "Are you very optimistic about Jiu'an Medical?"

    "The market is good, right? The flu is serious now, and Jiu'an's business abroad is very good."

    Li Xihai said this based on the analysis given by the system.

    He didn't know much about Jiu'an Medical's situation, he only got the information from the system.

    He used to be just an ordinary stock trader. When he broke in with his passion, all he learned was superficial.

    How much investment experience and basic theoretical knowledge do you have?

    To put it bluntly.

    He is just a pure novice player.

    Without a system, he would not dare to invest again.

    Since he had the golden finger of the system, Li Xihai didn't bother to waste any energy or brain cells.

    Those who have a system and work hard to make progress, study this theory and analyze that data all day long.

    So isn’t the system in vain?

    So, just lie down and that's it.

    Don't act blindly, don't think wildly.

    Wouldn’t it be nice to honestly invest according to the guidance of the system?

    "As long as you know what's going on."

    Father Li didn't say much anymore.

    The reason why I asked today was because the daily limit for three consecutive days and the profit of more than 300,000 yuan forced him to pay attention to it.

    He didn't have much to worry about.

    Sometimes he thinks very clearly, and what he earns is that his son has a good vision and a firm mind.

    It’s not a loss even if you lose it, it’s all earned anyway.

    It's just that he is worried that if something happens and more than 300,000 yuan is lost, his son will not be able to bear the huge gap and will have emotional problems.

    "It's time to eat."

    Mother Li shouted.

    Li Xihai and Li's father got up and went over, and Li Xiluo also came out of the room.

    After the family finished eating, Li's mother saw that Li Xihai had eaten little and asked warily: "You won't go out again tonight, will you?"

    "If you stay away all day and night, your home will become your hotel."
